encounter.title: Act I Encounter 7 — Square Candidate A (8x8 seed 12)
encounter.notes: LD-004 candidate A for Act I #7. 8x8 seed 12 (13 arrows: N1 E5 S4 W3). Escalates to a 3-front crossfire. Pattern: DIRECTION SCARCITY. West ammo is strictly scarce: exactly 3 West arrows exist on board, only 1 free on start (#0). Urgent triage required: #0(W) -> #1(W) kills Fast W before its turn 3 attack. Then #2(N) -> #12(E) -> #11(E) eliminates Heavy E before turn 5 attack. Finally #6(S) -> #7(S) eliminates Thrower S. 7 taps clean, 0 damage.
